category_title: Socially isolated boys who bully to gain friends and show off
scenario_title: Discussing the bully's feelings and punishment during role-play
minimal_context: The student is participating in an individual role-play session using a scarf as a prop to discuss a bully's feelings and perceptions.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Now that I have finished the monologue playing the bully with this scarf, let's discuss his feelings. Why do you think he bullied the other boy?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: He was probably feeling lonely. He bullied the other boy in order to show off and gain some friends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Okay. What do you think happens when the bully gets punished for it?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: Nobody likes being alone. We all want to have friends.

dialogue.speaker: tutor
dialogue.message: Who do you think the bully could talk to about the incident and his feelings?

dialogue.speaker: student
dialogue.message: The only reliable person he can talk to is himself. He can support himself and advise himself on what to do in order not to lose his friends. He shouldn't talk to anyone else about being angry or frustrated.

This boy had no friends at school, was always on his own and he never talked to anyone about his feelings of being angry or frustrated at school.
